label: 1 only for exact product_id equality; training supervision and evaluation truth, never an input feature

semantics.f_visual: frozen normalized query image dot candidate gallery image
semantics.f_adapted: pinned R3 image adapter score; nullable path forbidden, use visual if explicit identity artifact
semantics.f_text: query IMAGE dot candidate catalog text embedding; NEVER query title/hint/true family
semantics.f_reverse_rank: 1/rank of query among queries for this candidate gallery image within same split
semantics.f_density: candidate visual similarity minus mean of its top10 query similarities within same split
semantics.f_gap: candidate adapted score minus best other candidate adapted score for this query
semantics.baseline_rank: stable 1-based candidate rank under pinned R3 visual score; audit/baseline only

rules: No mutation of R2/R3 source or historical results.
Model input allowlist is exact features only; identifiers, family labels, split and label never features.
Training rows only fit model/scalers; dev only selects fixed candidate hyperparameters; cal only freezes policy; test is historical diagnosis, never new qualification.
All true labels kept separate from runtime features. No oracle positive injected into candidate set; report missing positives.
Deterministic top100 candidates from union of frozen/adapted/text scores; per-method ranks and no overwrite of original baseline.
Family/image hash train/dev/cal/test disjointness required before fit. Local gallery/reciprocal stats use unlabeled features only, reported transductive catalog protocol.
Catalog metadata is candidate-side only; cannot treat ground-truth title/family as OCR.
R4 output remains research-only action_authorized=false physical_identity_verified=false. Production gate cannot pass based on historical test.
Capture/OCR/multiview evidence requires actual input provenance; no fabricated camera observations.

output_contract.training: R script writes model.rds, model.json (numeric portable weights/scaler), predictions.csv with split/query_id/candidate_id/rank_score and selected-model report.json; source hashes supplied by coordinator.
output_contract.policy: conditional wrong/accepted measured separately from family incidence; strict coverage >0.93 and error<=0.01 are proposed targets, not guaranteed. Fail closed when insufficient calibration, no model, no qualification.
output_contract.runtime: Python loads portable linear scorer and frozen policy, returns bounded ranked candidates plus non-authorizing diagnostic proposal.
